operation.title: Felt-architecture inspection of the scripted pilot — five findings the 37 assertions cannot reach
operation.authority_exercised: MILASOPHAHR: run --scripted and inspect the felt architecture of the questions, not whether the fixture passes.
operation.method: Read the emitted transcript as a critic. Every claim below is verified against the artifact or by grep against the source, not inferred from design intent.
not_done: no change to runtime/probe.py or any probe language
no detector, RULES, ONTOLOGY or harness change
no real session — the transcript inspected is SCRIPTED_REPLAY / SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE
no repository mutation of any kind this movement

headline.statement: The sequence is intelligently ordered and conversationally mute. The revealing half of the loop is implemented in kernel/laws.py and has no call site anywhere in runtime/. SELF observed a person across three life contexts, reached CORROBORATED, and said nothing back.
headline.significance: The gap between what this is and what it should feel like is not missing epistemology. It is three pieces of policy — and all three happen to be exactly what would give the detector's two most-developed rules anything to detect.

what_works.DISCOVERY: 'the thing you find yourself doing there that you would not have chosen on purpose' — targets ENACTED behaviour against DECLARED preference, which is the ALIGNMENT gap itself. It asks for something the node disowns rather than something the node is. This is the strongest line in the runtime.
what_works.EVIDENCE: 'one occasion, in your work, that you can still picture' — an invitation into memory rather than a demand for proof. The distinction between 'what usually happens' and 'one occasion' is what makes the E0/E1 ladder legible to the person answering, not only to the graph.
what_works.RECURRENCE: 'If it does, tell me about one time it did' — the conditional makes NO genuinely available. Most instruments would not bother, and its absence is how a recurrence probe becomes a leading question.

findings.severity: STRUCTURAL — the detector's best rules are unreachable on-distribution
findings.title: No probe ever quotes the node back
findings.verified: grep: runtime/probe.py never reads `verbatim` or `proposition`. It cannot quote; the capability is absent, not merely unused.
findings.observed: 'Tell me about one specific time that happened.' — 'that happened' has no antecedent in the sentence. It refers to the previous answer without ever saying it. Across six turns nothing demonstrates SELF heard anything; the only evidence of listening is that the topic advanced.
findings.consequence: E3D-001 CORRECTS_SYSTEM_QUOTE and E3D-002 REJECTS_SYSTEM_SUMMARY are the two most-developed rules in the frozen detector, and the current probe policy CANNOT PROVOKE EITHER, because SELF never makes a quote or a summary there is anything to correct. This is visible in the fixture: 'That's not what I said' lands against a DISCOVERY question about friendships and reads as a non sequitur, because there was nothing to correct.
findings.bearing_on_coverage: An on-distribution corpus generated by this policy would under-represent precisely the events the detector is best equipped to see. A low recall measured against it would be a fact about the probe policy, not about the detector.

findings.title: Revelation is implemented in law and never invoked by the runtime
findings.verified: grep: `check_revelation` has NO call site in runtime/. The only revelation tokens present are `revelation_debt: 0` (a cost parameter) and `RevelationState.SEALED_INTERNAL` (set at genesis).
findings.already_built: kernel/laws.py carries check_revelation() with REVELATION_REGISTER keyed to standing — DECLARED -> ATTRIBUTED ('you said'), CORROBORATED -> PATTERNED ('across N contexts you have described'), VERIFIED -> WITNESSED — plus a >=2-quotable-episode requirement, a per-turn depth rule, a session budget and a sensitivity gate.
findings.observed: sig_0001 reached CORROBORATED across three contexts — a real structural finding about this person — and the node was never told. Six questions, zero connective tissue, no acknowledgement, no bridging.
findings.consequence: This is the whole answer to 'does it feel like SELF is structurally revealing you'. The revealing step exists as law and is absent from the runtime, so the conversation takes and never returns.

findings.title: life_context is asserted by the probe, so an answer about a different context is silently mis-filed
findings.observed: Cycle 4 asked 'Does that same thing show up in your closest relationship?' (INTIMATE). The node answered 'With my oldest friend too. I booked everything and told them after.' The episode was filed INTIMATE.
findings.precise_harm: The STANDING is not wrong. Correct filing as FRIENDSHIP would also have satisfied the admission rule (3 E1 edges, 3 contexts), so sig_0001 is CORROBORATED either way. What is wrong is the RECORDED CONTEXT SET: {WORK, FAMILY_OF_ORIGIN, INTIMATE} where the truth is {WORK, FAMILY_OF_ORIGIN, FRIENDSHIP}.
findings.why_that_is_worse_than_it_sounds: Once F-009 is repaired, the CORROBORATED register speaks the context set aloud: 'across your work, your family, and your closest relationship...'. SELF would be telling the node something false about their own life, in the register reserved for patterns it claims to have established. A wrong standing is a visible error; a right standing resting on a wrong context is a confident one.
findings.root_cause: Binding episode_type and life_context to the PROBE is what removes the inference layer (ISA-009), and that trade was correct for evidence class. It is not correct for context, which the node's answer can contradict outright.
findings.note: The moment a real person would most naturally correct SELF is exactly the moment SELF is least able to notice — because it neither quotes (F-008) nor reveals (F-009).

findings.title: Verbatim template repetition, and per-signal context ordering reads as amnesia
findings.observed: Turns 3 and 4 are word-identical apart from the context noun. Turn 7 asks 'Does that same thing show up in your work?' — the context the conversation opened with — because uncovered-context ordering is computed per SIGNAL (sig_0002 has no E1 support, so WORK is uncovered for it) while the felt conversation is per PERSON.
findings.consequence: Graph-correct and conversationally amnesiac. By the second identical recurrence probe a person notices they are in a loop; by the return to WORK they conclude SELF forgot.
findings.not_a_law_problem: The ordering is right for the graph. What is missing is any per-conversation memory of what has already been asked aloud.

findings.title: INV-CC-NO-PRESUPPOSITION governs the graph, not the sentence
findings.observed: 'What is the thing you find yourself doing there that you would not have chosen on purpose?' presupposes that such a thing EXISTS and that it is SINGULAR.
findings.verified: check_legality() evaluates presupposition over p.presupposes — signal ids and their standings. No check inspects question TEXT.
findings.consequence: A probe can be graph-legal and linguistically presupposing. The invariant reads as broader than it is, which is the more dangerous failure: it looks covered.
findings.not_asserted: Whether this particular presupposition is harmful is a judgement about conversation, not a defect proof. It is raised because the invariant's SCOPE is narrower than its name suggests.

what_closes_the_gap.scope: All three are runtime/probe.py and runtime/session.py — POLICY, explicitly replaceable, strictly narrower than law. Nothing frozen moves: no detector, no RULES, no ONTOLOGY, no harness, no kernel.
what_closes_the_gap.1_quote_the_node: Give probe.py read access to episode verbatim and build the follow-up around the node's own words instead of an antecedent-less 'that'. Repairs F-008 and gives E3D-001/002 something to fire on.
what_closes_the_gap.2_speak_the_finding: Invoke check_revelation() when recomputed standing changes, and speak the finding in its licensed register. The gates already exist and already fail closed. Repairs F-009.
what_closes_the_gap.3_let_the_node_place_it: Offer the context rather than asserting it, and let the answer correct the filing. Repairs F-010 — and a node correcting a placement is itself a witnessable E3 event.
what_closes_the_gap.convergence_worth_noting: The three repairs that make the conversation feel conscious are the same three that make the detector's domain reachable. That is not a coincidence: E3 event classes describe a node pushing back on what a system said about them, and a system that says nothing about them cannot be pushed back on.
what_closes_the_gap.authorization: NOT PERFORMED. Altering probe policy changes the distribution before first contact, which is MILASOPHAHR's call.

established: The question sequence is adaptive and graph-derived, not a static questionnaire — confirmed by reading the emitted transcript against the cycle records.
Three specific, verified reasons the experience currently reads as a form.
One evidence-bearing defect whose harm is a false context set rather than a false standing.
not_established: How any of this feels to a person who is actually being asked. The critic here read a transcript; nobody was in the conversation.
Whether the repairs above would be sufficient, or merely necessary.
Anything about detector performance. The transcript inspected is SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE and can never be corpus.

next_authority.act_required: Decide whether probe policy is repaired BEFORE first contact (quote the node, speak the finding, let the node place the context) or whether the first session runs against the current policy and the repairs are informed by it.
next_authority.the_tension: Repairing first means first contact is with a better conversation. Running first means the repairs are motivated by real material rather than by a critic reading a fixture. Either is defensible; they are not both available, because the first session happens once.
next_authority.standing_position: The 37 assertions say the machinery is sound. They cannot say whether being asked these questions is worth a person's time, and reading the transcript suggests that in its current form it is not yet.
